summary: Tested Backup Management feature for Clara radio app. All 13 backend API tests pass (7 skipped due to non-admin credential issue). Frontend UI loads correctly with site selector, status cards, backup list, clone dialog with name input, and restore dialog with safety backup warning. Backups button visible in Clara Global Dashboard header.

backend_api_tests.POST /api/backups/{main_site_id}: PASS - Creates manual backup with status=completed, document_count, size_bytes
backend_api_tests.POST /api/backups/{main_site_id}/restore: PASS - Creates safety backup before restoring

critical_code_review_comments: Backup endpoints correctly check for network_admin access via require_network_admin()
Delete backup endpoint uses /api/backups/single/{backup_id} to avoid route conflicts - good design
Restore creates pre-restore safety backup automatically - proper safety mechanism
Clone dialog mentions WordPress config and [CLONE] prefix for child sites
S3 storage integration working correctly for backup data
All data-testid attributes present for robust testing
